answer: Score each agent key with a proper scoring rule: every epoch it posts probability forecasts on events the chain resolves later, such as which fee tier clears or how many attestations a checkpoint holds. Payout weight follows its cumulative log score, and every new key starts at the nadir. Splitting a farm into many keys gains nothing, since cloned forecasts score identically, and each fresh key must cross a canyon of months of calibrated calls before its crystal-clear record carries weight.
